news.title: Sheinbaum Unveils Affordable EV Prototype Backed by Government
news.description: An electric vehicle startup backed by the Mexican government unveiled its first prototype in a ceremony featuring President Claudia Sheinbaum, who praised the project as an affordable mobility option and a showcase for homegrown engineering.

news.title: Nvidia, SK Hynix Seal Multi-Year Pact to Develop AI Chips
news.description: Nvidia Corp. and SK Hynix Inc. have agreed to partner on designing future generations of memory chips for AI, a win for a South Korean leader vying with Samsung Electronics Co. in a red-hot arena.
